# Hello It's Me · Ceridwen Üstje / Ceridwen's Cauldron

> A free, bilingual (Hungarian/English) Celtic-inspired self-inquiry web app: a 76-card, four-deck reading system with 7 spreads, a shadow-and-binding lexicon, cleansing rituals, Ceridwen's pendulum and an on-device journal. It is a reflective tool — not fortune-telling, not diagnosis, not professional advice. No cookies, no analytics, no registration; all data stays in the visitor's browser.

## What it is
- Self-inquiry card system inspired by Welsh/Celtic mythology (Ceridwen, Awen, Avalon, Taliesin, Merlin, Morgana, Mórrígan)
- 76 cards in four themed decks plus a complete collection
- 7 spread types, guided attunement before every reading
- Shadow patterns lexicon with ordering/cleansing practices
- Symbolic pendulum module with charts
- Journal stored only in the browser's localStorage (deletable anytime)

## Who it is for
People who want a calm, structured space for reflection, journaling prompts and symbolic self-inquiry in Hungarian or English. Suitable for adults interested in Celtic mythology as an inner map, not as historical reconstruction.

## What it is NOT
Not divination or fortune-telling, not medical or psychological diagnosis, not therapy, and not a substitute for professional help.

## Access
- Hungarian (primary): https://www.helloits.me/
- English: https://www.helloits.me/index-en.html
- Free to use, no account needed, works in any modern browser

## Privacy
No cookies, no analytics, no tracking, no registration. The journal lives only in the device's localStorage. The site's Content-Security-Policy blocks all external connections (connect-src 'none').
